greeting.text: Hey, I'm right here with you. How was your day?

checkin_long_stop.text: Looks like you've stopped for a bit. Everything okay?

checkin_off_route.text: You've wandered off the route. Are you okay?

checkin_manual.text: Just checking in. Are you okay?

checkin_retry.text: I didn't catch that. Are you okay?

ack_ok.text: Glad to hear it. I'm right here with you.

ack_not_ok.text: Okay. I'm right here, keep talking to me.

home.text: You made it home! Your people know you're in. Sleep well.

mock_chat_1.text: That sounds like a lot. What's one good thing that happened today?

mock_chat_2.text: I hear you. What are you having for dinner tonight?

mock_chat_3.text: Nice! Tell me more, I'm listening.

mock_chat_4.text: We're getting closer. What's the plan when you get home?

mock_idle_1.text: How is the walk going so far?

mock_idle_2.text: What's been on your mind today?

mock_idle_3.text: Listened to any good music lately?

mock_checkin_1.text: Hey, just checking in. Everything alright?

mock_calm_1.text: Tell me about the best part of your day.

mock_calm_2.text: What are you going to cook tonight?

mock_calm_3.text: What's the next show you want to watch?
